about: Page-element rules found by Intoponet's own measurement (scripts/protection-crawl.mjs) and accepted by a person (reviewed.json). hide: containers that held nothing but ads at every publisher where they were seen. whenEmpty: ad slots, hidden once nothing but an ad label is left in them. publishers = at how many measured publishers the name was seen, onlyAds = at how many of those every instance held only ads, withAnAd = at how many an ad was in it at the time. Generated by scripts/protection-classify.mjs.
